Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Do not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.

- commit-commands:commit-push-pr: Commit, push, and open a PR
- commit-commands:clean_gone: Cleans up all git branches marked as [gone] (branches that have been deleted on the remote but still exist locally), including removing associated worktrees.
- commit-commands:commit: Create a git commit
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

message.content: In a separate session, I added caching to the script. Read the update script, and update the above prompt to include instructions for adding caching

content.content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Claude Code status line command
3	# Reads JSON from stdin and outputs a formatted status line
4	
5	input=$(cat)
6	
7	# Extract all fields in one jq pass (bash 3.2-compatible — no mapfile)
8	_f=()
9	while IFS= read -r line; do _f+=("$line"); done < <(echo "$input" | jq -r '
10	  (.model.display_name // "unknown"),
11	  (.effort.level // ""),
12	  (.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0 | tostring),
13	  (.context_window.used_percentage // ""),
14	  (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // ""),
15	  (.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // "" | tostring),
16	  (.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""),
17	  (.transcript_path // "")
18	')
19	model="${_f[0]}"
20	effort="${_f[1]}"
21	total_tokens="${_f[2]}"
22	used_pct="${_f[3]}"
23	five_pct="${_f[4]}"
24	five_resets="${_f[5]}"
25	cwd="${_f[6]}"
26	transcript="${_f[7]}"
27	
28	# 1. Model and effort level
29	if [ -n "$effort" ]; then
30	  model_str="$model [$effort]"
31	else
32	  model_str="$model"
33	fi
34	
35	# 2. Context tokens and percentage
36	tokens_fmt=$(printf "%'d" "$total_tokens" 2>/dev/null || echo "$total_tokens")
37	if [ -n "$used_pct" ]; then
38	  ctx_str="ctx: ${tokens_fmt} tok ($(printf '%.0f' "$used_pct")%)"
39	else
40	  ctx_str="ctx: ${tokens_fmt} tok"
41	fi
42	
43	# 3. Current working directory (below ~/src/) and git branch
44	src_prefix="$HOME/src/"
45	if [[ "$cwd" == "$src_prefix"* ]]; then
46	  rel_cwd="${cwd#$src_prefix}"
47	else
48	  rel_cwd="$cwd"
49	fi
50	branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
51	if [ -n "$branch" ]; then
52	  dir_str="${rel_cwd} (${branch})"
53	else
54	  dir_str="${rel_cwd}"
55	fi
56	
57	# 4. 5h subscription session usage and reset time
58	if [ -n "$five_pct" ] && [ -n "$five_resets" ]; then
59	  now_ts=$(date +%s)
60	  secs_left=$(( five_resets - now_ts ))
61	  if [ "$secs_left" -gt 0 ]; then
62	    hrs_left=$(( secs_left / 3600 ))
63	    mins_left=$(( (secs_left % 3600) / 60 ))
64	    if [ "$hrs_left" -gt 0 ]; then
65	      remaining_str="${hrs_left}h ${mins_left}m remaining"
66	    else
67	      remaining_str="${mins_left}m remaining"
68	    fi
69	  else
70	    remaining_str="reset now"
71	  fi
72	  rate_str="5h session: $(printf '%.0f' "$five_pct")% ($remaining_str)"
73	elif [ -n "$five_pct" ]; then
74	  rate_str="5h session: $(printf '%.0f' "$five_pct")%"
75	else
76	  rate_str=""
77	fi
78	
79	# 5. Prompt cache eviction countdown (60 min from last assistant message)
80	# Cache the last-seen assistant timestamp in a tmpfile to avoid re-scanning on every refresh
81	cache_str=""
82	if [ -n "$transcript" ] && [ -f "$transcript" ]; then
83	  cache_file="/tmp/ccstatusline_$(echo "$transcript" | md5).ts"
84	  # Only re-scan if transcript has grown since last check
85	  transcript_size=$(stat -f%z "$transcript" 2>/dev/null)
86	  cached_meta=$(cat "$cache_file" 2>/dev/null)
87	  cached_size="${cached_meta%%:*}"
88	  cached_epoch="${cached_meta##*:}"
89	  if [ "$transcript_size" != "$cached_size" ]; then
90	    last_ts=$(tail -n 100 "$transcript" | grep '"type":"assistant"' | tail -n 1 | sed 's/.*"timestamp":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
91	    if [ -n "$last_ts" ]; then
92	      ts_clean="${last_ts%%.*}"
93	      ts_clean="${ts_clean%Z}"
94	      ts_epoch=$(TZ=UTC date -j -f "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" "$ts_clean" +%s 2>/dev/null)
95	      if [ -n "$ts_epoch" ]; then
96	        echo "${transcript_size}:${ts_epoch}" > "$cache_file"
97	        cached_epoch="$ts_epoch"
98	      fi
99	    fi
100	  fi
101	  if [ -n "$cached_epoch" ]; then
102	    now=$(date +%s)
103	    evict_at=$((cached_epoch + 3600))
104	    remaining=$((evict_at - now))
105	    if [ "$remaining" -gt 0 ]; then
106	      mins=$((remaining / 60))
107	      cache_str="cache: ${mins}m"
108	    else
109	      cache_str="cache: \033[31;1mexpired\033[0m"
110	    fi
111	  fi
112	fi
113	
114	# ANSI color codes (light, subtle)
115	C_RESET='\033[0m'
116	C_MODEL='\033[38;5;110m'    # light steel blue   — model/effort
117	C_CTX='\033[38;5;150m'      # light sage green    — context tokens
118	C_RATE='\033[38;5;216m'     # light peach/orange  — 5h session usage
119	C_DIR='\033[38;5;183m'      # light lavender      — working dir/branch
120	C_CACHE='\033[38;5;152m'    # light cyan-grey     — cache eviction
121	C_SEP='\033[38;5;240m'      # dim grey            — separator
122	
123	# Assemble: model | ctx | cwd/branch | 5h session | cache
124	colored_parts=()
125	colored_parts+=("${C_MODEL}${model_str}${C_RESET}")
126	colored_parts+=("${C_CTX}${ctx_str}${C_RESET}")
127	colored_parts+=("${C_DIR}${dir_str}${C_RESET}")
128	[ -n "$rate_str" ] && colored_parts+=("${C_RATE}${rate_str}${C_RESET}")
129	[ -n "$cache_str" ] && colored_parts+=("${C_CACHE}${cache_str}${C_RESET}")
130	
131	# Join with separator
132	printf '%b' "${colored_parts[0]}"
133	for part in "${colored_parts[@]:1}"; do

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Claude Code status line command
# Reads JSON from stdin and outputs a formatted status line

input=$(cat)

# Extract all fields in one jq pass (bash 3.2-compatible — no mapfile)
_f=()
while IFS= read -r line; do _f+=("$line"); done < <(echo "$input" | jq -r '
  (.model.display_name // "unknown"),
  (.effort.level // ""),
  (.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0 | tostring),
  (.context_window.used_percentage // ""),
  (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // ""),
  (.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // "" | tostring),
  (.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""),
  (.transcript_path // "")
')
model="${_f[0]}"
effort="${_f[1]}"
total_tokens="${_f[2]}"
used_pct="${_f[3]}"
five_pct="${_f[4]}"
five_resets="${_f[5]}"
cwd="${_f[6]}"
transcript="${_f[7]}"

# 1. Model and effort level
if [ -n "$effort" ]; then
  model_str="$model [$effort]"
else
  model_str="$model"
fi

# 2. Context tokens and percentage
tokens_fmt=$(printf "%'d" "$total_tokens" 2>/dev/null || echo "$total_tokens")
if [ -n "$used_pct" ]; then
  ctx_str="ctx: ${tokens_fmt} tok ($(printf '%.0f' "$used_pct")%)"
else
  ctx_str="ctx: ${tokens_fmt} tok"
fi

# 3. Current working directory (below ~/src/) and git branch
src_prefix="$HOME/src/"
if [[ "$cwd" == "$src_prefix"* ]]; then
  rel_cwd="${cwd#$src_prefix}"
else
  rel_cwd="$cwd"
fi
branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then
  dir_str="${rel_cwd} (${branch})"
else
  dir_str="${rel_cwd}"
fi

# 4. 5h subscription session usage and reset time
if [ -n "$five_pct" ] && [ -n "$five_resets" ]; then
  now_ts=$(date +%s)
  secs_left=$(( five_resets - now_ts ))
  if [ "$secs_left" -gt 0 ]; then
    hrs_left=$(( secs_left / 3600 ))
    mins_left=$(( (secs_left % 3600) / 60 ))
    if [ "$hrs_left" -gt 0 ]; then
      remaining_str="${hrs_left}h ${mins_left}m remaining"
    else
      remaining_str="${mins_left}m remaining"
    fi
  else
    remaining_str="reset now"
  fi
  rate_str="5h session: $(printf '%.0f' "$five_pct")% ($remaining_str)"
elif [ -n "$five_pct" ]; then
  rate_str="5h session: $(printf '%.0f' "$five_pct")%"
else
  rate_str=""
fi

# 5. Prompt cache eviction countdown (60 min from last assistant message)
# Cache the last-seen assistant timestamp in a tmpfile to avoid re-scanning on every refresh
cache_str=""
if [ -n "$transcript" ] && [ -f "$transcript" ]; then
  cache_file="/tmp/ccstatusline_$(echo "$transcript" | md5).ts"
  # Only re-scan if transcript has grown since last check
  transcript_size=$(stat -f%z "$transcript" 2>/dev/null)
  cached_meta=$(cat "$cache_file" 2>/dev/null)
  cached_size="${cached_meta%%:*}"
  cached_epoch="${cached_meta##*:}"
  if [ "$transcript_size" != "$cached_size" ]; then
    last_ts=$(tail -n 100 "$transcript" | grep '"type":"assistant"' | tail -n 1 | sed 's/.*"timestamp":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$last_ts" ]; then
      ts_clean="${last_ts%%.*}"
      ts_clean="${ts_clean%Z}"
      ts_epoch=$(TZ=UTC date -j -f "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" "$ts_clean" +%s 2>/dev/null)
      if [ -n "$ts_epoch" ]; then
        echo "${transcript_size}:${ts_epoch}" > "$cache_file"
        cached_epoch="$ts_epoch"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$cached_epoch" ]; then
    now=$(date +%s)
    evict_at=$((cached_epoch + 3600))
    remaining=$((evict_at - now))
    if [ "$remaining" -gt 0 ]; then
      mins=$((remaining / 60))
      cache_str="cache: ${mins}m"
    else
      cache_str="cache: \033[31;1mexpired\033[0m"
    fi
  fi
fi

# ANSI color codes (light, subtle)
C_RESET='\033[0m'
C_MODEL='\033[38;5;110m'    # light steel blue   — model/effort
C_CTX='\033[38;5;150m'      # light sage green    — context tokens
C_RATE='\033[38;5;216m'     # light peach/orange  — 5h session usage
C_DIR='\033[38;5;183m'      # light lavender      — working dir/branch
C_CACHE='\033[38;5;152m'    # light cyan-grey     — cache eviction
C_SEP='\033[38;5;240m'      # dim grey            — separator

# Assemble: model | ctx | cwd/branch | 5h session | cache
colored_parts=()
colored_parts+=("${C_MODEL}${model_str}${C_RESET}")
colored_parts+=("${C_CTX}${ctx_str}${C_RESET}")
colored_parts+=("${C_DIR}${dir_str}${C_RESET}")
[ -n "$rate_str" ] && colored_parts+=("${C_RATE}${rate_str}${C_RESET}")
[ -n "$cache_str" ] && colored_parts+=("${C_CACHE}${cache_str}${C_RESET}")

# Join with separator
printf '%b' "${colored_parts[0]}"
for part in "${colored_parts[@]:1}"; do
  printf '%b' "${C_SEP} | ${C_RESET}${part}"
done
printf '\n'
